title: Doc: Amazon, wary of AI agents favoring sites with better data, plans to gather data on nearly every product sold anywhere, including by crawling rivals' sites (Greg Bensinger/Reuters)
summary: Greg Bensinger / Reuters: Doc: Amazon, wary of AI agents favoring sites with better data, plans to gather data on nearly every product sold anywhere, including by crawling rivals' sites — Amazon (AMZN.O) has a secret plan to ensure shoppers never need to leave its site: own the world's product information.
